execution: CPU NumPy only; no network, GPU, model inference, training or source writes

normalizer.scope: raw stored source-copy labels; no normalizer causality claim

evidence_levels.E3: offline counterfactual or operational proxy, not behavioral causality

calibration.units: newton (raw sensor values, no gravity compensation, no torque)
calibration.channel_note: Left wrist 3-axis force + left finger-pad normal forces + left gripper actuation force. Not a six-axis wrench: no torque channel is present, and the wrist components are in the flange frame.

identity.critical_limit: Force-source embedded action copy is NOT proof of v1g actual 40k action labels. Dataset reads actions from dataset_dirs v1g, force18 from force_arrays_path; only ep_start/ep_len/row count checked. Upstream a3_fw is 8D proprio, not v1g942 identity.

window_rule.valid_starts_per_episode: 0..L-33 inclusive; count L-32; no episode crossing/padding

mechanism.deadzone: abs(delta)<=1e-4 inherits; strict >/<; first deadzone defaults -1; last label duplicates penultimate
mechanism.float_precision_limit: original op float64 lost; stored opening float32. Mismatch near threshold cannot alone falsify original implementation.

macro_proxy.definition: joint_cmd deltas >1e-4, group consecutive active same-sign movements (holds ignored), cumulative command travel >=0.1; start at forward delta index
macro_proxy.units: opening/joint_cmd native units, not calibrated physical aperture
macro_proxy.timing: first correct label within min(20 frames, command-run end); signed nearest same-direction transition within +/-20; matches not one-to-one; 20Hz => 50ms/frame
macro_proxy.warning: proxy depends on 0.1 cutoff; not task success, optimal control or definitive ground truth

offline_candidates.deadzone: forward delta threshold plus inherited state
offline_candidates.hysteresis: switch after cumulative retreat from running directional extreme > threshold; causal after next measurement, no future beyond baseline delta; no min dwell
offline_candidates.falsification: reject candidate if macro missed events or timing delays unacceptable; jointly inspect dense windows and true command reversals, never pick on flip count alone

interpretation_limits: Tiny measured opening motion with constant command supports measured micro-motion, not proof of sensor noise (no independent sensor/noise calibration).
Opening movement and same-direction command changes support commanded motion, not every binary label flip being a real command reversal.
Threshold crossing maps small continuous variation to full +/-1 targets (jump 2), then deadzone inheritance prolongs it: deterministic preprocessing amplification, not evidence normalizer created it.
This recovered force asset corrects a missing local identity search result; it does not recover v1g actions, original normalizer, or prove inference failure causality.
